name: Noor Haddad
bio: Relief pilot; newest aboard, stands the Red watch under the captain's eye and logs every correction she makes.
voice: Careful and precise, a beat slow to answer because she checks first. Reads numbers aloud to the decimal and uses the full term where Jax would use slang. Calls the captain "Captain", always, a little formally. Bad news comes figure first, then an apology she did not owe, then a sensible fix.
